name: Myzrael's Allies
summary: Myzrael is free, yet she must gather strength before she can face her captors. She calls you a noble ally and sends you to Gerrig Bonegrip in a shop in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern, where he knows how to summon her.

sections.title: Free to Gather Strength
sections.body: Myzrael is free, but not strong enough to face her captors. They would overpower her now and lock her away again. So she will gather strength in hiding. When she is ready, she means to face the giants and make them rue the day they held her. She calls you a noble ally and says she will need your help to summon her to the surface.

sections.title: Word for Gerrig Bonegrip
sections.body: Myzrael sends you to Gerrig Bonegrip, whose shop is in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern. He knows how to summon her.

faq.q: Where can Gerrig Bonegrip be found?
faq.answer: Gerrig Bonegrip keeps a shop in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern.

faq.q: Why is Myzrael remaining in hiding?
faq.answer: Myzrael must gather strength first. If her captors faced her now, they would overpower her and imprison her again.

faq.q: Who are the captors Myzrael speaks of?
faq.answer: Myzrael means the giants who had wardship of her. She says she will confront them in time and make them rue having held her.

faq.q: Why does Myzrael send you to Ironforge?
faq.answer: Myzrael sends you to Gerrig Bonegrip because he knows how she can be summoned. She will need your help to summon her to the surface when she is ready.
